title: Sources: ASML has discussed raising prices for its EUV systems with TSMC and plans to charge 10% more for its DUV systems; TSMC is resisting ASML's plans (Qianer Liu/The Information)
summary: Qianer Liu / The Information: Sources: ASML has discussed raising prices for its EUV systems with TSMC and plans to charge 10% more for its DUV systems; TSMC is resisting ASML's plans — Chip toolmaker ASML, which makes equipment that plays a central role in chip production around the world, plans to raise prices …
